description: Makes a person the top result when someone Googles their name, and the person AI assistants name when asked who they are. Uses OpenSEO to check where the name ranks today, whether Google already shows a knowledge panel, what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude say, and whether the person's site has any real backlinks.
